title: NATS watch resubscription must wait for round-trip ack, not just local SUB success
answers: Why does natsNotifier retry subscribing instead of using it right away?
NATS watch missed events after reconnect
How should a notifier confirm a NATS subscription is truly active?
body:
Symptom: natsNotifier reports it 'subscribed to nats watch stream' and starts forwarding events, but under disconnect/reconnect the subscription was only queued client-side and events get lost before the server actually processes SUB.
Root cause: natsNotifier.trySubscribe (pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats.go) previously treated Subscribe() returning without error as success.
Fix pattern: after Subscribe(), call sub.WaitReady(ctx) with a context bounded by defaultMaxBackoff; on WaitReady failure, call sub.Unsubscribe() and return false so the outer backoff loop retries instead of declaring the watch live.
Constraints: applies specifically to the retry/backoff path that establishes live capture (trySubscribe); it does not apply to notifiers (channel/polling) that don't talk to an external bus.
says: Live event stream loses messages after connection recovery
Watcher says it connected but events never arrive
Subscription succeeds locally but server never actually processes it
How do I verify event subscription is confirmed server-side
Real-time events skip data after unexpected disconnection happens
search: NATS watch resubscription in pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats.go:natsNotifier.trySubscribe must call sub.WaitReady(ctx) after Subscribe() to wait for server round-trip acknowledgment, not just local SUB success. Without this call, resubscription under disconnect/reconnect appears live while events are silently lost before the server processes the SUB frame. The context passed to WaitReady should be bounded by defaultMaxBackoff; if WaitReady fails, call sub.Unsubscribe() and return false to trigger outer backoff loop retry instead of declaring the watch live. This rule applies specifically to the retry/backoff path that establishes live capture and does not apply to notifiers using channels or polling instead of external bus connection. Snapshot-to-live guarantees break if resubscription succeeds locally without waiting for server-side round-trip ack.
